verdict.rationale: SAM.gov ships its own public REST APIs (Entity, Opportunities, Exclusions, Contracts and others). They use key-based authentication, offer System Accounts for machine access, return JSON/CSV, and support pagination, so non-interactive scripted access is possible. Nothing documents CI or headless workflows as such: there is no CLI, System Accounts need approval, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at standard machine paths. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-oriented guidance, documented non-interactive key provisioning without manual approval, a machine-discoverable OpenAPI endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Users can make GET calls using any Browser or a Restful API client such as Postman.
Users must create their System Account using the “System Accounts” widget and get it approved.
registered users must obtain the API Key from the https://sam.gov/workspace/profile/account-details page using the field, “Public API Key”.
This API supports pagination as needed.
